title: US stocks today: US markets rebound from lows, but inflation, Iran war worries persist
summary: US stocks rebounded from a three-day selloff, with the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow ending higher. However, persistent inflation concerns, a global bond selloff and escalating US-Iran tensions kept investors cautious, while weak jobs data raised concerns about corporate spending and the US economic outlook.
